column1: # The bridge between doc/verification.md and tb/tests/. One line per runnable
# test; tab-separated; '#' starts a comment line.
#   T-id <TAB> uvm_test <TAB> wp <TAB> requirements <TAB> timeout_s <TAB> red
# T-id          must match the ID used in doc/verification.md (T-01, T-06, ...)
# uvm_test      the UVM test class name, i.e. tb/tests/<uvm_test>.sv
# wp            the work package that owns the test (0 = baseline / pilot)
# requirements  comma-separated FR-NN ids the test is evidence for, '-' if none
# timeout_s     hard wall-clock limit for one xsim run, in seconds
# red           mutant:<name>: the <name> row of scripts/verify/mutants.tsv reintroduces the defect
#               this test covers; the negative control rebuilds it and requires the test to fail
#               no: the test predates the flow; there is no mutant yet
# Optional 7th column, `sanity:<image>`: the test is the UVM sanity harness and
# runs a pre-built riscv-tests image. regress.cmake passes +HEX/+TOHOST (the
# tohost address is read from the ELF, never hardcoded) and requires both
# `UVM_RESULT: PASS` and `SANITY: PASS` in the log.
# A test listed here must exist in tb/tests/<uvm_test>.sv. After adding a line,
# re-run ./configure so CMake picks up the new sim_<uvm_test> target.
# wp 0 - baseline: the tests that existed before the work-package flow
# wp 6 - store width, lane and strobes (FR-11). T-13/T-14/T-15 now carry their mutants (lane, halfword strobe, width cast) added with the catalogue rows in P4.
# wp 7 - RV32I closure (E4): one image per unstimulated instruction bin; every row carries its mutant (P3)
# T-37 is the local image scripts/verify/sanity/local/rv32ui-p-jalr_unaligned.S; every WP-7 row now carries its mutant
# wp 7 P4b - the last five acceptance-cell instructions get a named test each (bne, ori, slli, lui, auipc); the images already pass, the mutant is the proof
# wp 7 follow-up (FR-01): T-01 only ever issues ADD as `add x0,x0,x0`, so no test observed an ADD result. rv32ui-p-add
# checks one directly: TESTNUM 3 is `add rd,1,1` == 2, and `alu-ignore-rs2` makes it store 3. The mutant is shared
# with T-29..T-36; each row is applied independently (as branch-always-taken is for T-19..T-22 and T-38).
